claims.finding: Bulgaria blocked North Macedonia's accession in 2020 and lifted the veto on 24 June 2022 by adopting the French presidency proposal. That other member states opposed the veto is documented in outline but 'the whole EU' is an overstatement.

evidence.statement: Bulgaria did impose a veto on North Macedonia's EU accession process in 2020, and it lifted it on 24 June 2022 by adopting the French EU Council Presidency's proposal. BNT reports that the National Assembly voted 170 in favour of giving the government a mandate to accept the French proposal and that this 'lifts the veto imposed by Bulgaria in 2020'. The decision was conditional on the 2017 friendship treaty, Bulgarians being written into North Macedonia's constitution on an equal footing with other peoples, no recognition of a 'Macedonian language', and European guarantees. This directly contradicts Iotova's debate statement that she does not remember Bulgaria ever imposing a veto.
evidence.quote: Със 170 гласа "за" парламентът прие предложението на "Демократична България" за предоставяне на мандат на Министерски съвет да приеме предложението на Френското председателство за Северна Македония. НС на практика дава мандат на МС да приеме т.н. френско предложение за започване на преговори на Северна Македония с ЕС и вдига ветото, наложено от България през 2020 г.
evidence.source: БНТ Новини — „Парламентът свали ветото за Северна Македония – вижте при какви условия“

evidence.statement: The official text of the 47th National Assembly's decision confirms the conditions attached to the French proposal. The decision (State Gazette No. 48 of 28 June 2022, adopted 24 June 2022) authorises the government to approve the draft negotiating framework and Council conclusions proposed by the then EU Council Presidency only if the text guarantees that Bulgarians are written into North Macedonia's constitution in the provisions mentioning other peoples and on an equal footing, that nothing in the accession process can be read as Bulgarian recognition of a 'Macedonian language', that good-neighbourliness remains a horizontal criterion, and that the 2017 treaty and joint committee protocols are referenced. This is the primary legal text behind the 'French proposal' vote.
evidence.quote: Решение на Четиридесет и седмото Народно събрание на Република България във връзка с разширяването на Европейския съюз и процеса на преговори на Република Северна Македония ... evidence.source: Държавен вестник, бр. 48 от 28.06.2022 г. — Решение на 47-ото Народно събрание във връзка с разширяването на ЕС и процеса на преговори на Република Северна Македония

evidence.statement: Art. 92(1) makes the president head of state who 'represents the Republic of Bulgaria in international relations' - a representative function, which is what Iotova invoked and what Gyurov countered with 'we are a parliamentary republic'. Art. 98 lists the president's powers (scheduling elections and, where the NA has so decided, a referendum; addressing the nation and the NA; concluding international treaties 'in the cases provided by law'), Art. 99 governs cabinet formation and the caretaker cabinet (para 5), Art. 102(3) lists decrees needing no countersignature, and Art. 84(11) reserves to the National Assembly the authorisation of the deployment and use of the armed forces.

claims.finding: Set for Sunday 1 November 2026; the date is the Day of the National Awakeners.

evidence.statement: The runoff was set for Sunday 1 November 2026. Campaigning ended at midnight on 30 October and Saturday 31 October was the legally protected day of reflection, when no campaigning or publication of opinion polls was allowed. This fixes the chronology: the debate was on 29 October, the last campaign day on 30 October, silence on 31 October, and the vote on 1 November.
evidence.quote: Агитацията приключва в полунощ, а на 31 октомври е ден за размисъл. На 1 ноември Илияна Йотова и Андрей Гюров ще се борят за президентския пост.
evidence.source: Fakti.bg - „Последен ден на кампанията преди президентския балотаж“

counter_evidence.statement: The runoff date, 1 November 2026, is listed in art. 154(1) of the Labour Code among Bulgaria's official holidays as the Day of the National Awakeners (Ден на народните будители), but the code makes it a non-attendance day only for educational institutions, not a general non-working day. So the runoff coincided with an official holiday, though most workplaces were open.
counter_evidence.quote: 1 ноември - Ден на народните будители - неприсъствен за всички учебни заведения
counter_evidence.source: Lex.bg - Кодекс на труда, чл. 154, ал. 1 (консолидиран текст)
